Application for a specialized Master's degree program
Those interested in a specialized Master's program listed below must apply in two stages:
Pre-registration with the department in question:
Master «Global Futures: Development, Sustainability, Social Justice»
Master Evolutionary Language Science
Master of Science UZH ETH in Quantitative Finance
Master's in History of the Contemporary World/Zeitgeschichte
Master's in Wirtschaftsgeschichte
Master's in Studi Italiani
Specialized Master’s study programs at the Faculty of Science
Please note the pre-registration deadlines!
Student Services will notify you of the next steps once you have received a provisional confirmation of admission from the department.
Additional Information
Applicants with Visa Requirements
Please note that prospective students who require a visa need the admission decision three months before their planned entry in order that the national visa D can be issued on time.
This is only possible if the deadline for applicants with visa requirements is met and all documents relevant for admission are available.
